g.text: The null keeps every descriptor's size and every lipid's number of descriptors; only which lipids share a descriptor is randomized.

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: Circles and squares mark two lipid classes: declared descriptors group like with like, the null mixes them.

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: Lower is better. Matched null and biochemical descriptors share shape, so their gap isolates biochemical membership.
